Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Treatment of moderate to severe vaginal dryness, a symptom of vulvar and vaginal 
atrophy (VVA), due to menopause*

AND 
 
2 - History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to BOTH of the following:  
• 
Estradiol vaginal cream  
• 
Estradiol vaginal tablet  
Notes  
*Treatment of dyspareunia is a benefit exclusion.
